info.title: FitBook API
info.description: Backend for FitBook: coach catalog, availability, individual and group bookings (single and recurring), free trial, mock payments, notes and realtime chat. All dates are ISO 8601 UTC; money is integer cents.

id.description: Send it back to POST /auth/verify and /auth/verify/resend.

purpose.description: signup: confirm a new / unverified email. login: second sign-in step.

expiresAt.description: When the current code stops working (10 minutes).

resendAvailableAt.description: When "Resend code" becomes allowed (60 seconds after each send).

HomeArea.description: Where the user trains or coaches

address.example: 1600 N Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60613

CancellationPolicy.description: Clients may cancel only if at least this many hours remain

expiresAt.description: Unpaid bookings are released at this time

cancellable.description: Whether the client can still cancel right now

address.example: 1600 N Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60613

CalendarEvent.description: Data for adding the training to the device calendar

participant.description: The other person in the conversation

post.summary: Register with email and password (role and home area required). Emails a 6-digit code; tokens come from POST /auth/verify.
post.description: An email of an unverified account is not taken: that account is overwritten with the new data and its previous codes stop working.

post.summary: Check email and password and email a 6-digit code (purpose "login", or "signup" for an unverified email). Tokens come from POST /auth/verify.
Check the emailed code and start a session
post.description: Errors in order: NOT_FOUND (unknown id), VERIFICATION_CODE_EXPIRED (used, code older than 10 minutes or verification older than 30 minutes), TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS (5 wrong codes; a resend resets it), VERIFICATION_CODE_INVALID (details.attemptsLeft). A signup verification also confirms the email.

post.summary: Email a new code for the same verification (old code stops working, attempts reset)
post.description: Allowed from resendAvailableAt (60 seconds after each send), at most 5 times. Too early -> RATE_LIMITED with details.retryAfterSeconds. Used, expired or resend limit reached -> VERIFICATION_CODE_EXPIRED (sign in / sign up again).

post.summary: Sign in with a Google ID token (no email code). New accounts must complete POST /me/onboarding.
Sign in with an Apple identity token (no email code). New accounts must complete POST /me/onboarding.
Exchange a refresh token for new tokens (rotation; reuse revokes the session family)
Revoke a refresh token
Email a 6-digit reset code (always 204, no user enumeration)
Verify the reset code and get a short-lived reset token
Set a new password with the reset token: signs out all sessions, confirms the email and starts a new session (no extra code)

patch.summary: Update name, avatar, home area or theme

post.summary: Complete onboarding for social sign-in accounts (role + home area)

patch.summary: Change or set password (current password required if one exists). Signs out all other sessions and returns a new token pair for this device.

get.summary: Is the free trial still available for me?
Coach catalog (published coaches; my state first unless a state filter is given)
Coach profile: bio, experience, certifications, highlights, training types and prices
Free start times for an individual training type (range up to 31 days)
Upcoming group sessions of a coach with spots left

put.summary: Update my coach profile (unpublishes automatically if it becomes incomplete)

post.summary: Publish or hide my profile in the catalog

put.summary: Set how many hours before a training clients can still cancel

get.summary: My training types (individual and group, with prices)

post.summary: Create a training type

patch.summary: Update a training type (price, title, duration, capacity, location, active)
patch.description: Existing bookings keep the price they were booked with.

delete.summary: Delete a training type (deactivated instead if it was already used)

get.summary: My weekly working hours and exceptions (times are local to my time zone)

post.summary: Add or replace an exception for a date (no start/end = whole day off)

delete.summary: Remove the exception of a date

post.summary: Book an individual training (optionally the free trial) or join a group session
post.description: Individual: `{sessionTypeId, startAt, isTrial?, location?}`. Group: `{sessionId}`. Paid bookings start as `pending_payment` and are released if not paid in time; the free trial is confirmed immediately.

get.summary: My bookings for the calendar: upcoming (ascending) or past (descending)

post.summary: Preview a recurring series: which dates are free

time.description: Start time in the coach's time zone

post.summary: Book the chosen dates of a recurring series (taken dates are skipped)

time.description: Start time in the coach's time zone

post.summary: Pay all pending bookings of a series (mock payment)

get.summary: Booking details (client or coach of the booking)

post.summary: Pay a pending booking (mock payment)
Cancel my booking (confirmed bookings only within the coach's free-cancellation window)

get.summary: Event data for adding the training to the device calendar

post.summary: Cancel a booking of mine with a reason (any time before the start)
Schedule a group session, optionally repeating on weekdays for N weeks
Cancel an upcoming group session and all its bookings

get.summary: My work calendar: sessions with participants in a range (up to 62 days)
Notes of a training, grouped into before and after

post.summary: Add a note before or after the training (coach or client of the booking)

patch.summary: Edit a note (both participants can edit any note of their training)

get.summary: My conversations, most recent first, with unread counts

post.summary: Open (get or create) a conversation: clients pass coachId, coaches pass clientId

get.summary: Messages, newest first. Pass nextCursor as `before` to load older ones.

post.summary: Send a message (also delivered in realtime via Socket.IO)
Mark all messages from the other person as read
